description: This file defines a React component 'ChatUI' that provides a comprehensive user interface for interacting with various language models and media endpoints. It includes state management, UI controls, message handling, media uploads, and integration with backend API calls for chat, image, audio, and other modalities.

classes.name: ChatUI
classes.description: A React functional component implementing a comprehensive chat interface with support for multiple media types, models, and tools.

methods.name: loadMCPTools
methods.description: Fetches available MCP tools from backend API based on current API key.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Multiple React hooks managing lifecycle events like fetching models, agents, and session persistence.

methods.name: updateTextUI
methods.description: Appends received text chunks to the chat history, aggregating if from the same role.

methods.name: updateReasoningContent
methods.description: Updates the reasoning content of the last assistant message.

methods.name: updateTimingData
methods.description: Updates timing metrics (e.g., time to first token) for the last assistant message.

methods.name: updateUsageData
methods.description: Updates token usage information for the last assistant message.

methods.name: updateA2AMetadata
methods.description: Stores A2A-specific metadata for the last message.

methods.name: updateTotalLatency
methods.description: Records total latency for assistant response.

methods.name: updateSearchResults
methods.description: Attaches search results to the latest assistant message.

methods.name: handleResponseId
methods.description: Stores response session identifier.

methods.name: handleToggleSessionManagement
methods.description: Enables or disables API session management.

methods.name: handleMCPEvent
methods.description: Updates MCP events based on received event data.

methods.name: updateImageUI
methods.description: Appends an image message to chat history.

methods.name: updateEmbeddingsUI
methods.description: Appends embeddings content to chat history.

methods.name: updateAudioUI
methods.description: Appends audio message to chat history.

methods.name: updateChatImageUI
methods.description: Attaches an image to the last assistant message or creates a new one.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events in message input area.

methods.name: handleCancelRequest
methods.description: Aborts ongoing API request.

methods.name: handleImageUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading of images for editing.

methods.name: handleRemoveImage
methods.description: Removes specific uploaded image.

methods.name: handleRemoveAllImages
methods.description: Clears all uploaded images.

methods.name: handleResponsesImageUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading image for responses API.

methods.name: handleRemoveResponsesImage
methods.description: Removes uploaded response image.

methods.name: handleChatImageUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading image for chat.

methods.name: handleRemoveChatImage
methods.description: Removes uploaded chat image.

methods.name: handleAudioUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading audio files.

methods.name: handleRemoveAudio
methods.description: Removes uploaded audio files.

methods.name: handleSendMessage
methods.description: Main function handling message sending, API calls, and UI updates.

methods.name: clearChatHistory
methods.description: Resets chat history and various states.
